message.content: It's been about four days now. My skin and eyes have been getting more yellow each day, my stools have gone dark, and I feel very tired and lightheaded. I haven't had any belly pain or fever, and I haven't noticed any bleeding. I don't know about itching, weight loss or urine color since you haven't mentioned those in my history. As for my history, I have advanced lung cancer that has spread to my adrenal gland and under my diaphragm. I got my first dose of an immunotherapy drug, pembrolizumab, 14 days ago. I also have gastritis and high cholesterol, and I had my gallbladder removed in the past. I'm a former smoker. I don't know of any liver disease, and nothing was mentioned about heavy alcohol use.
